mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_message (user_id, title, content, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type})

INSERT INTO sys_message (user_id, title, content, type) SELECT u.id, #{title}, #{content}, #{type} FROM `user` u JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN `role` r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND u.status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
